description: Source code for a utility that modifies headers in firmware images, specifically adding U-Media specific fields and recalculating CRCs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that parses command-line arguments and initiates header fixing.

methods.name: fix_header
methods.description: Reads firmware image, verifies and updates header fields, recalculates CRC, and writes back.

methods.name: check_options
methods.description: Validates input and output files and retrieves file size.

methods.name: write_fw
methods.description: Writes modified firmware data to output file.
